items.criterion: Zero-loss is real, not just a digest self-check: every shipped block's whitespace-normalized text is a verbatim substring of its actual source file, and the host leg actually executes rather than skipping.
items.detail: Re-ran the host containment assertion directly (tests/test_spec_ingest.py:316-329 logic) against the real sources: code-factory 80 blocks / 0 not-verbatim; coding-hermes-director 1027 / 0; auger-docs 139 / 0. `pytest -v` shows all three parametrized host tests PASSED (no SKIPPED lines), and _resolve_source_file resolves to existing files (/home/kara/code-factory/specs/ENVELOPE.md, /home/kara/specs/coding-hermes-director/DESIGN.md, /home/kara/auger/docs/DESIGN.md).

items.criterion: The recall battery's hit metric is honest: a hit requires the target block in the top-5 DISTINCT blocks (not rows), and misses are reported rather than silently counted.
items.detail: scripts/recall_battery.py:209-221 _rank/_hit dedupe by key via _distinct_keys and accept only the exact target id or a `<target>-P` part; run_battery records per-query rank/top5 and prints misses. Pinned by tests test_recall_hit_counts_distinct_blocks_not_rows, test_recall_battery_hit_is_top_five_blocks_and_wide_window and test_recall_battery_reports_misses_instead_of_passing, all PASSED in the 19-passed run.

items.criterion: The committed report's numbers agree with a fresh live run (no stale or fabricated hit rate).
items.detail: evidence/AUG-176/06-recall-battery.md:74-77 reports code-factory 11/12 (92%), auger-docs 9/12, coding-hermes-director 7/12, total 27/36; my fresh live run printed "code-factory: 11/12 hit rate 92%" (exit 0), matching the committed code-factory row and the 27/36 total arithmetic.

items.criterion: The converted corpora are reachable through the registry entrypoint: `auger spec validate` and `auger spec check` return rc 0 for all three corpora.
items.detail: `auger.py spec validate corpora/code-factory` -> "spec: 7 document(s), 80 block(s), 0 reference(s) ok" rc 0; `spec check` -> {"status": "valid"} rc 0. auger-docs: 14 documents/139 blocks rc 0; coding-hermes-director: 22 documents/1027 blocks rc 0. Same arms run in tests/gate.sh:338-345.
